title: ChatGPT Privacy Settings Most Users Don't Know Exist (Turn These Off Now)
description:
Every ChatGPT conversation trains OpenAI's AI by default. Most users have never seen the setting to turn it off.

Here are 4 settings most people don't know exist:

1. Model training toggle (OFF by default for privacy)
2. Memory feature (building a profile of you)
3. Temporary Chat mode
4. Delete all your stored data

#ChatGPT #AIPrivacy #QuickWin #OpenAI #DigitalPrivacy #MadingThok
